dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope all goes well with you.

dialogues.speaker: Tejima
dialogues.text: As for you? Are you going to continue traveling?

dialogues.speaker: Tejima
dialogues.text: If so, please take these. These are some experiences from when I was younger that I've written down. Nothing would make me happier than if they could be of use to you.
